import sys
sys.path[:0] = ['services/core-api/src', '.']
from pydantic import ValidationError
from research_observatory_core.parsing.contracts import DocumentIR
from tests.parsing.contract_fixtures import rich_ir_wire
for label, mutation in [('citation', lambda v: v['citations'][0].update(marker=v['references'][0]['rawText'])), ('reference', lambda v: v['references'][0].update(rawText=v['citations'][0]['marker'])), ('table-cell', lambda v: v['tables'][0]['cells'][0].update(rawText=v['references'][0]['rawText']))]:
    value = rich_ir_wire()
    mutation(value)
    try:
        DocumentIR.model_validate(value)
    except ValidationError as error:
        assert any('ir-semantic-node-content-mismatch' in part['msg'] for part in error.errors(include_input=False))
        print(label + ': REJECTED ir-semantic-node-content-mismatch')
    else:
        raise AssertionError(label + ': contradiction accepted')
DocumentIR.model_validate(rich_ir_wire())
print('valid-rich-ir: ACCEPTED')
